# Narrative Encyclopedia

## Story Types

### Main Arc

- Generated based on player choices
- 3-5 acts per playthrough
- Choices affect ending branches

### Side Quests

- Procedurally generated
- Faction reputation linked
- 5 concurrent max

### Character Stories

- NPC personal quests
- Romance paths (optional)
- Backstory reveals

### World Events

- Global narrative impacts
- Faction wars
- Natural disasters

## Quest Structure

```
Quest
+-- Title
+-- Description
+-- Objectives[]
¦   +-- Primary (required)
¦   L-- Secondary (optional)
+-- Choices[]
¦   +-- Visible consequences
¦   L-- Hidden consequences
+-- Rewards[]
¦   +-- XP
¦   +-- Items
¦   L-- Reputation
L-- Parent Quest (optional)
```

## Narrative Rules

1. Every choice has consequences
2. NPCs remember player actions
3. World evolves without player
4. No throwaway dialogue

## Emotion Adaptation

| Pattern | Emotion | Adaptation |
|---------|---------|------------|
| Fast actions | Excitement | Speed up, more action |
| Frequent deaths | Frustration | Simplify, add hints |
| Slow exploration | Curiosity | Add details, secrets |
| Repeating actions | Boredom | Add surprises |
| Long absence | Disengagement | Hook on return |

## Player Types & Content

- Explorer > lore, secrets, locations
- Achiever > rewards, achievements
- Socializer > NPCs, dialogues
- Killer > combat, challenges
